I_2359.title: Unhandled undici promise rejections crash gateway during network blips
symptoms: Gateway process terminates during brief network interruptions
Happens during WiFi handoffs or VPN reconnections
I_2359.root_cause: Unhandled promise rejections in undici HTTP library during transient network issues. Missing .catch() handlers on fetch operations.
I_2359.impact: UNACCEPTABLE for production - Service completely unavailable during minor network hiccups
immediate_mitigation: Use process manager (PM2, systemd) with automatic restart
Set process.on('unhandledRejection') handler to log but not crash
Wrap all fetch calls in try-catch
I_2359.production_impact: Frequent outages in real-world network conditions. Unacceptable SLA.
I_2359.priority: P0 - MUST FIX before production deployment

I_2272.title: Gateway crashes on transient network failures (unhandled fetch rejection)
symptoms: Gateway crashes when provider API temporarily unavailable
Temporary DNS resolution failures cause termination
I_2272.root_cause: Lack of retry logic and error recovery for temporary network failures. Assumes network is always available.
I_2272.impact: Service terminates on temporary issues instead of recovering. Violates basic reliability requirements.
immediate_mitigation: Add circuit breaker for repeated failures
I_2272.production_impact: Cannot maintain uptime SLA. Requires 24/7 monitoring and manual restarts.

I_2369.title: Add network resilience for unhandled fetch failures
symptoms: Unhandled network fetch failures cause service disruptions
I_2369.root_cause: Missing error handling for network fetch operations across the codebase
I_2369.impact: Production instability; service interruptions during network issues

I_2365.title: Session lock not released on API failure
symptoms: Session becomes permanently locked after API errors
Future operations blocked with 'session locked' error
Accumulates over time as errors occur
I_2365.root_cause: Lock release logic missing in error handling paths. No finally blocks to ensure cleanup.
I_2365.impact: Sessions become permanently locked; requires manual cleanup; resource leaks accumulate
immediate_mitigation: Add finally blocks to all lock acquisition code
Periodic cleanup job to release stale locks
I_2365.production_impact: System becomes progressively unusable. Requires periodic restarts.

I_1812.title: Deadlock between cron timer lock and agent tool calls
symptoms: System completely hangs when cron and agent operations overlap
I_1812.root_cause: Lock ordering issue causing mutual blocking. Cron acquires lock A then B; agent acquires lock B then A.
I_1812.impact: Complete system hang; requires process restart; unpredictable occurrence makes it dangerous
immediate_mitigation: Add lock timeout with automatic release
Deadlock detection and recovery (break deadlock by releasing youngest lock)
Avoid overlapping cron and agent operations
I_1812.production_impact: Random complete service outages. Unacceptable for production.

I_1862.title: Messages lost during gateway restart (race condition)
symptoms: Messages sent during restart window disappear
I_1862.root_cause: Race condition during gateway shutdown/startup transition. Messages accepted but not persisted.
I_1862.impact: MESSAGE LOSS - Zero-downtime deployments not possible; violates data durability guarantees
I_1862.production_impact: Cannot meet enterprise data durability requirements. Unacceptable for production.

I_788.title: Messages/responses leak between providers (crosstalk)
symptoms: Responses from wrong provider appear in conversation
Session data appears in wrong conversation
User reports seeing other users' data
I_788.root_cause: Weak session→provider binding. Routing logic can incorrectly associate sessions with wrong provider.
I_788.impact: PRIVACY BREACH - Trust violation, potential regulatory violation (GDPR, HIPAA)
detection: Audit log: provider_id mismatch between request and response
Canary tests: send test messages, verify provider isolation
immediate_mitigation: Hard pin provider per session (no switching mid-session)
I_788.production_impact: BLOCKER for enterprise and regulated industries. Unacceptable privacy risk.

I_1826.title: Synthetic tool_result for terminated tool_use causes all subsequent requests to fail
symptoms: All subsequent API requests fail with validation errors
I_1826.root_cause: Invalid synthetic tool results break API message format. Repair mechanism creates malformed messages.
I_1826.impact: Session becomes unusable after tool termination; requires restart
I_1826.production_impact: Severe impact on user workflows. Tool failures cascade to session failures.

I_2271.title: Images >5MB cause infinite retry loop and block session completely
symptoms: Large image upload triggers infinite retry loop
Session completely blocked, no further messages processed
I_2271.root_cause: Lack of image size validation and retry circuit breaker. No maximum retry limit.
I_2271.impact: Session completely blocked; users cannot continue work; requires manual restart
immediate_mitigation: Reject oversized images with clear error message
I_2271.permanent_fix: Add file size validation + circuit breaker pattern

I_2244.title: Gateway crashes on systems with hostname > 63 bytes (mDNS label limit)

Allow manual hostname override in config
